text:
sam_release: Heads-up — planning to enable cinder-13b-v2 in the model catalog in 30m change window. Canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Fallback ordering will be set; monitoring owned by @neha_sre and @jordan_pm. Release notes/PR: https://redwood-internal/release/PR-2345

deploy-bot: Job queued: catalog-enable pr=2345 user=sam_release. ETA ~2m. Logs at https://ops/redwood/deploys/2345

alex_prod: Quick flag — pin legal-enterprise customers to cinder-13b-v1 before broader enablement.

sam_release: Ack. Pinning now: `/catalog pin legal-enterprise cinder-13b-v1`

qa-bot: Canary smoke tests started. Basic generation checks OK. Median latency +3ms vs baseline. Unit tests pass.

neha_sre: Monitoring thresholds set: roll back if error_rate > 0.8% OR p95 latency > 20% vs baseline. I'll watch dashboards and traces.

jordan_pm: Small ask — for low-memory instances can we prefer rw-2.1-quant as the second fallback instead of cinder-13b-v1? Might avoid OOMs.

sam_release: Good point. Updating priority map to:
```
priority_map:
  - cinder-13b-v2
  - rw-2.1-quant
  - cinder-13b-v1
```
Pushing that into the enable command.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Enabling catalog entry 'cinder-13b-v2' for prod.canary=10%. Workers started on gpus-alloc-12. Watch: https://ops/redwood/deploys/2345/console

neha_sre: Observing p95 latency spike for cinder-13b-v2 in eu-west-1 — ~+28% vs baseline. Error rate still low (<0.3%) but latency breach is past our rollback threshold. Paging @oncall.

oncall: oncall: Received page — looking at traces now. Traces show longer kernel runtimes for sequences >1024 tokens on that GPU family.

neha_sre: Given threshold hit (p95 >20%), recommendation: immediate rollback of canary to avoid user impact.

sam_release: Initiating hot rollback now. `/deploy catalog disable cinder-13b-v2 --scope=prod.canary --reason="p95 latency breach"`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Disable request acknowledged. Rolling back canary... draining connections, reassigning traffic. Reverting priority map to cinder-13b-v1, rw-2.1-quant while investigation proceeds.

alex_prod: Confirming customer pins remain on cinder-13b-v1 — no user-facing change for pinned tenants.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete. cinder-13b-v2 disabled on prod.canary. Current priority map: cinder-13b-v1, rw-2.1-quant. Rollback details: https://ops/redwood/deploys/2345/rollback

sam_release: Filing post-rollout note in PR-2345. Initial root cause: kernel scheduling regression for long sequences on that GPU type. Eng-runtime assigned to investigate (@eng-runtime).

jordan_pm: I'll update release notes and schedule a follow-up canary next Tue 10:00 PT after runtime fixes and a short perf test matrix.

neha_sre: :thumbsup: Good triage. Saving traces and attaching spike logs to the incident. If eng-runtime wants more repro data ping me and I can run targeted traces.

qa-bot: Re-running canary smoke once runtime fix is available. Will post results to this thread.

sam_release: Thanks all — closing this rollout for now. Will reopen when kernel fixes land and perf is stable.
